### Dominion Energy Highlights Energy-Saving Tools During Energy Awareness Month


10/05/2026


[Download this Press Release (opens in new window) PDF 543 KB](https://s205.q4cdn.com/611413639/files/Dominion-Energy-Highlights-Energy-Saving-Tools-During-Energy-Awareness-Month.pdf)


*Customers can monitor cost per day, analyze energy use*


**CAYCE, S.C. (Oct. 5, 2026)** – With the[Energy Analyzer](https://www.dominionenergy.com/south-carolina/paying-my-bill/understand-my-bill/energy-analyzer) , Dominion Energy South Carolina customers can get daily and monthly details about their energy use to help lower their bill.


“Understanding how their home uses energy can help our customers identify the impact of seasonal changes, see how much energy different appliances use and make informed choices about low- to no-cost ways to reduce their monthly bill,” said Gerald Freeman, program manager for Dominion Energy South Carolina. “Customers can also enroll in[Energy Alerts](https://www.dominionenergy.com/south-carolina/paying-my-bill/energy-usage-alerts) to monitor their cost per day and to receive notifications on changes in energy use, helping them stay informed ahead of their monthly bill.”


With the Energy Analyzer, customers can:


- View easy-to-read charts showing energy use over time.
- See an estimated breakdown of how energy is used in their home.
- Compare month-to-month energy use.
- Review insights that help them better understand usage patterns.


Combining these tools with energy efficiency programs and helpful tips can be even more impactful. Energy efficiency commonly starts at the thermostat. Follow these HVAC tips:


1. **Adjust thermostat settings seasonally.** Set the thermostat lower during cooler weather and open windows during cool mornings and evenings instead of running the air conditioner. HVAC systems typically account for the largest portion of residential energy use, so even small thermostat adjustments can produce meaningful savings. Disable or check unnecessary auxiliary heat settings on heat pumps.
2. **Use programmable or smart thermostats.** Create a thermostat schedule to automatically adjust temperatures overnight or when no one is home.
3. **Avoid extreme settings and keep air filters clean.** Adjust the thermostat setting a few degrees at a time. Major changes to temperature settings, as well as clogged or dirty air filters, can cause HVAC systems to work harder and consume more energy.


Dominion Energy offers a variety of programs to help customers manage energy use and costs, including:


- [Home Energy Check-up](https://www.dominionenergy.com/south-carolina/save-energy/home-energy-check-up) and[EnergyWise Online Savings Store](https://energywiseshop.com/) : Resources to help customers identify energy-saving opportunities and purchase discounted energy-efficient products.
- [Heating and cooling](http://www.dominionenergysc.com/hvac) and natural gas rebates: Incentives may be available for eligible energy-efficient heating, cooling,[water-heating](https://www.dominionenergy.com/south-carolina/save-energy/thermwise) and[fireplace upgrades](https://www.dominionenergy.com/south-carolina/save-energy/thermwise-rebates) .
- [You Shift/You Save](https://www.dominionenergy.com/south-carolina/save-energy/you-shift-you-save) and[Reward Hours](https://www.dominionenergy.com/south-carolina/save-energy/reward-hours) : Programs that provide opportunities for eligible customers to manage electric use during periods of high demand.
- Business energy efficiency programs:[Small businesses](https://www.dominionenergy.com/south-carolina/save-energy/small-business-incentives) , nonprofits,[commercial and industrial](http://www.dominionenergysc.com/foryourbusiness) customers may be eligible for incentives to help reduce the upfront cost of energy-efficiency improvements.


To learn more about programs, including customer eligibility and restrictions, as well as more tips on how to be more energy wise, visit[DominionEnergy.com/SaveEnergy](https://www.dominionenergy.com/SaveEnergy) or call 877-510-7234.


**About Dominion Energy**


Dominion Energy (NYSE:[D](https://investors.dominionenergy.com/home/default.aspx) ), headquartered in Richmond, Va., provides regulated electricity service to[3.6 million](https://www.dominionenergy.com/our-company/operating-segments) homes and businesses in Virginia, North Carolina, and South Carolina, and regulated natural gas service to 500,000 customers in South Carolina. The company is one of the nation’s leading developers and operators of regulated[offshore wind](https://www.dominionenergy.com/projects-and-facilities/wind-power-facilities-and-projects/coastal-virginia-offshore-wind) and[solar](https://www.dominionenergy.com/projects-and-facilities/solar-energy-facilities-and-projects/virginia-solar-projects) power and the[largest producer of carbon-free electricity in New England](https://www.dominionenergy.com/projects-and-facilities/nuclear-facilities/millstone-power-station) . The company’s mission is to provide the[reliable, affordable, and increasingly clean energy](https://www.dominionenergy.com/our-company) that powers its customers every day. Please visit[DominionEnergy.com](http://www.dominionenergy.com/) to learn more.
